maps.question: What are the major families inside metaphysics families, and what pressure point does each family expose?
maps.summary: Source-grounded draft based on 8 ingested chunk(s). Prompt: Map the major metaphysical families from ingested source chunks, including their claims, pressure points, contributors, key texts, and relations. Sources: Metaphysics families source brief.

groups.stance: Physicalist and materialist metaphysics begin from the claim that reality is ultimately physical, or at least that every real phenomenon depends on the physical order.
groups.centralClaim: Hobbes gives an early modern body-and-motion version.

groups.title: Idealism
groups.stance: Idealist traditions treat mind, experience, reason, or spirit as basic to reality's intelligibility.
groups.centralClaim: Berkeley argues that ordinary objects are ideas sustained by perception.
groups.whyItMatters: Kant makes the structure of experience central by asking what conditions make objects possible for us.

groups.title: Dualism
groups.stance: Dualist families insist on a deep distinction between mind and matter, soul and body, or intelligible and sensible reality.
groups.centralClaim: Plato gives one ancient source through soul and forms.
groups.whyItMatters: Descartes gives the modern mind-body problem its sharpest canonical form.

groups.title: Substance and hylomorphism
groups.stance: Substance metaphysics asks what kinds of things exist and what makes them persist as one thing through change.
groups.centralClaim: Aristotle's hylomorphism treats beings as composites of form and matter, potentiality and actuality.
groups.whyItMatters: Aquinas adapts this vocabulary to being, essence, causation, and theology.

groups.title: Process and becoming
groups.stance: Process metaphysics starts from activity, change, relation, and becoming rather than static substance.
groups.whyItMatters: Whitehead rebuilds metaphysics around occasions, creativity, relation, and event.

groups.title: Neutral monism and panpsychism
groups.stance: Neutral monism and panpsychism try to avoid choosing between strict physicalism and strict dualism.
groups.centralClaim: Spinoza gives a dual-aspect model where mind and body express one substance.
groups.whyItMatters: Russell and James open routes where experience, structure, or neutral stuff can underlie both mind and matter.

groups.centralClaim: Peirce links meaning to conceivable practical effects while keeping truth tied to inquiry.
